prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIX-frame seamless running loop sprite sheet for a pixel-art side-scrolling game. Input image is the EXACT villager identity and pixel-style reference: preserve face, species anatomy, hair/fur/wood/metal, clothing design, colours, proportions, and patches. Create 6 successive DISTINCT RUNNING-IN-PLACE poses, perfectly regular 3 columns by 2 rows, left-to-right then top-to-bottom order. Canvas 1536x1024, each cell exactly 512x512. ALL SIX CHARACTERS FACE SCREEN-LEFT: every nose points to the LEFT edge of its cell, any tail trails behind to the RIGHT. Absolutely NEVER face screen-right or turn around, including bottom middle and bottom right. Torso leans toward screen-left; arms pump opposite legs. Six run phases: near-leg forward contact, near-leg push-off, airborne passing, far-leg forward contact, far-leg push-off, opposite airborne passing. Alternate near/far limbs WITHOUT rotating or mirroring the character. Run with bent knees and airborne phases, not walking, not six duplicate poses. Natural small bounce and cloth/hair/tail motion. Fixed pelvis/root center x=256 in every cell, ground reference y=470; complete head/ears/feet/tail inside own cell with 90px margin; constant character body scale only 300px tall. Exactly two arms and two legs, anatomically correct feet/hooves/paws/root feet matching reference. Genuine fully transparent alpha backdrop, no gradients, glow halos, vignette, floor/shadows, checkerboard painting, grid lines, text, weapons, props or additional characters. Crisp detailed pixel art like reference, no smoothing. Frame 6 loops into frame 1 naturally.  Character baudron-male. CRITICAL: each silhouette INCLUDING the ENTIRE TAIL must fit x=85..427 and y=150..470 within its own 512px cell. Tails curl compactly up behind the body. Leave wide completely empty transparent gutters between all six frames. Small sprites centered in large cells.
